No cron line, no systemd unit: an n8n dispatcher lane, like unit-run-snapshot.

purpose.text: On the 1st of each month at 06:00 ET, list each provider's models (GET /v1/models), diff them against config/llm_model_registry.json and the credit policy's routed tier models, record price/context/limits for new ids (never a guessed price), plan the capped eval, and write data/runtime/llm_model_scout/<YYYY-MM>.json plus one llm_model_scout_runs row. Advisory: it never changes routing.

connects_to.name: n8n -> host relay -> gateway coordination/run -> tradeai-n8n-run-executor

healthy.text: at shadow every dispatcher fire runs --dry-run: RUN_DONE mode dry_run, no output, no receipt
after promotion: the monthly fire ends RUN_DONE in mode live
LaneRunReceipt data/runtime/llm-model-scout_last.json ok_at advances on each live run
a live run reports produced_count 1 (one report)

degraded.text: output_signal older than 32 days but younger than 35 days

failed.text: a run ends RUN_FAILED, RUN_TIMEOUT or RUN_REFUSED; exit 3 is a P1 finding: a routed model is no longer listed or is marked retired
a finished live run left no RunReceipt (exit 0 is not evidence)

baseline.freshness_rule: monthly cadence: degraded beyond 32 days, failed beyond 35 days
baseline.source: no live runs yet (shadow); one manual dry run 2026-11-07 finished in a few seconds

alerting.severity_basis: a routed model the provider no longer lists breaks a lane silently (design §5.2 step 2, P1)
alerting.routing: SIEM row n8n:<lane> by scripts/n8n_siem_bridge.py; the receipt's error names each P1 model. The lane itself sends nothing.
alerting.enforced: partial: SIEM/notifier coverage of this lane is NOT_MEASURED (N8N_MONITORING_AND_REMEDIATION_STANDARD.md §7).

remediation.note: not in config/n8n_remediation_catalogue.json: a P1 is an operator/lead decision (registry change), never an automatic fix.
